name: godot-codex-studio
description: Structured Godot 4 game-development workflows for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, build, and validate Godot 4 games in Codex.
interface.longDescription: Godot 4 workflows for concept, narrative, design, production, QA, release, and operations. The optional local MCP bridge is installed only after explicit approval and must pass an editor canary.
defaultPrompt: Use $godot-start-project to route my Godot game project.
Use $godot-adapt-story to turn this story into a game plan.
Use $godot-ingest-project to assess my existing Godot project.
